result.summary: Step 0.5: read docs/issues/ISS-0020.yaml in full (item 2, the named precedent) plus widened the search and found a closer precedent, docs/issues/ISS-0036.yaml (identical unused-default-arg-in-test-helper shape, resolved ADHOC-20260817-002 by dropping the default). Neither is a recurrence -- ISS-0044's three groups are new instances of the same warning classes, so severity stays MINOR. Full diagnosis (all reproduced directly, not taken from the issue's prose) written into docs/issues/ISS-0044.yaml's new `diagnosis:` field; summarized here. GROUP 1 (register_test/4 deprecation, 5 property blocks) -- CONFIRMED, DEFER. mix.exs pins {:stream_data, "~> 0.6"}; mix.lock resolves 0.6.0. deps/stream_data/lib/ex_unit_properties.ex:174,223 call the deprecated 4-arity ExUnit.Case.register_test/4 inside stream_data's own `property` macro -- none of Letflow's test files call register_test directly. Installed toolchain is Elixir/ExUnit 1.18.3 (`mix --version`), which deprecated the 4-arity form. Reproduced: `mix test` on the 5 named files emits exactly these 5 warnings at exactly the reported lines; `MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force` exits 0 (test/*.exs is outside :test's elixirc_paths, mix compile never touches these files). Issue's own claim CONFIRMED. New finding: `mix hex.info stream_data` (network reachable) shows releases up to 1.4.0 vs. locked 0.6.0 -- an upgrade path may exist but is a 4-major-version jump, register_test/6 usage and generator-API compatibility in 1.4.0 are UNVERIFIED (only 0.6.0 vendored locally). DEFER -- not a same-file mechanical fix; a stream_data bump needs its own scoped requirement. GROUP 2 (unused default args, 4 call sites) -- CONFIRMED, FIXABLE NOW (mechanical). Read all 4 defp definitions and grepped every call site in each file (defp is file-local, so this is the complete set): sandbox_pool_test.exs:70 start_pool!(opts \\ []) -- 7 call sites (131,157,193,224,244,267,297), all pass explicit opts; fixture_loader_test.exs:44 start_pool!(opts \\ []) -- 1 call site (60), passes max_concurrent: 2; search_test.exs:107 create!(schema_name, overrides \\ %{}) -- 7 call sites (123,124,127,202,204,229,256), all pass an explicit map; service_scope_validator_test.exs:32 node(id, type, attributes \\ nil) -- 1 call site (385), passes attributes explicitly. Reproduced: mix test emits exactly these 4 warnings at exactly the reported lines. Same shape as the ISS-0036 precedent. Correct minimal fix per site: drop the `\\ <default>` -- do NOT manufacture a new short-arg call site (that would add new test behavior as a side effect of a hygiene fix, TEST-DESIGNER's lane not this one's). Each site individually passes all six of ORCHESTRATOR.md sec10's direct-action checks (single file, no new public function/module/@spec, no migration, no supervision file, no tenant-data path, no test-asserted value change since every call already supplied the arg); bundled as one 4-file fix it fails check 1 ("exactly one file") -- ORCH's call whether to run 4 single-file direct actions or one CODE-DESIGNER batch. GROUP 3 (migration module redefinition) -- CONFIRMED, SAME MECHANISM AS ISS-0020 ITEM 2, DEFER (non-blocking, no fix needed). Read the migration file in full: ordinary tenant-scoped migration, standard prefix()-guard, nothing unusual. Traced the actual call path (not assumed): mix.exs's `test:` alias runs `ecto.migrate --quiet` before `test`, which loads this migration module via Ecto's own migrator (Code.compile_file/1, deps/ecto_sql, no ensure-loaded guard) on its first pass. Separately, test/letflow/event_store/registry_test.exs:131-138 carries a documented, deliberate workaround (Code.require_file/1 on this exact file) for a real functional gap already described in that file's own comment and in lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex's tenant_scoped_migrations/0 moduledoc: priv/repo/migrations/*.exs is outside :test's elixirc_paths, so Ecto.Migrator.run/4's {version, module} form raises Ecto.MigrationError unless something loads the module first. registry_test.exs's Code.require_file/1 is idempotent against itself but has no visibility into ecto.migrate's earlier, separate load -- so its first call in a run still recompiles an already-defined module, producing the warning. Reproduced: ran the full suite (MIX_TEST_PARTITION=2 mix test: 704 tests/5 properties/0 failures, matching the issue's reported count) and captured the warning verbatim at priv/repo/migrations/20260816163103_create_event_type_registry.exs:40, firing exactly once, immediately before a test provisioning a req024-* tenant. Compared directly against ISS-0020 item 2's resolution text and independently re-verified its central claim in this environment: `MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force` exits 0 (priv/repo/migrations/ is outside elixirc_paths entirely, so mix compile can never trigger this warning). DEFER -- non-blocking, no fix required.
